name: LegendTile
label: Legend tile
description: The labelled value tile under a chart: a series dot, the series name, and its reading, on a soft neutral fill.

props.name: label
props.description: The series name shown above the value. Truncates with an ellipsis rather than wrapping.

props.name: value
props.description:
The reading for this series. A number is written in `locale`;
pass a string when the value carries its own formatting or a unit.

props.name: swatch
props.description:
Any CSS colour for the series dot — consumers typically pass a chart
palette token, e.g. `var(--color-chart-series-1)`. When omitted, no dot
renders.

props.name: locale
props.description:
The BCP 47 locale a number `value` is written in, such as `de-DE`. Defaults to `en-US`.
LegendTile can render from a Server Component, so it takes the prop alone and reads no LocaleProvider.
